# Requirements Document

## Introduction

Fixture requirements used by the basic fixture spec tree.

## Requirements

### Requirement 1: Crate foundation

#### Acceptance Criteria

1. When the crate is built, it shall produce the binary.
2. When the binary runs, it shall parse the arguments.
3. When the release is approved, it shall publish.

### Requirement 2: Reporting

#### Acceptance Criteria

1. The reporter shall list tasks.
2. The reporter shall report the next task.
